What share of working residents of the Bronx earned $1,250 a month or less in 2019?

SELECT sum(ce01) AS low_wage, sum(c000) AS all_workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'ny' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '36005'
Which Texas cities have the most hazardous waste sites on EPA's list?
SELECT city_name, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities WHERE state_code = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many NIH-funded projects were based at organizations in New York in fiscal year 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_state = 'NY' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2022'
Which states saw the most home loans made in 2022?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS loans FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of reactions taken from published applications change from 2002 to 2015?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2002', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which counties in New York have the highest median household income?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_income FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.variable = 'B19013_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many master reactions does Rhea define?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_directions
Where do families wait longest to get into subsidized housing?

SELECT name, states, try_cast(months_waiting AS double) AS months_waiting FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' AND try_cast(total_units AS double) >= 1000 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many companies filed an electric quarterly report for the second quarter of 2016?
SELECT count(DISTINCT company_id_ferc) AS companies FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_quarterly_identity WHERE year_quarter = '2016q2'
How do housing choice vouchers compare with public housing in total units nationwide?
SELECT program_label, sum(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE try_cast(total_units AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which countries outside the United States produce the most patented inventions?
SELECT raw_country, count(*) AS locations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_location_not_disambiguated WHERE raw_country <> 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the molecular formula of caffeine?
SELECT m.c1 AS formula FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = m.c0 WHERE t.c1 = 'Caffeine'
Which states have the most judicial positions on record?
SELECT location_state, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE position_type = 'jud' AND coalesce(location_state, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
On net, how much electricity did New York's grid send to its neighbours in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double)) AS net_mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND data_date LIKE '%/2022'
How has Veterans Affairs contract spending in Florida changed from 2018 to 2025?

SELECT action_date_fiscal_year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'FL' AND action_date_fiscal_year BETWEEN '2018' AND '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
How much did section 527 political groups report raising in July 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions WHERE substr(cast(column16 AS varchar), 1, 6) = '202407'
How many federal contract actions went to companies in Buffalo in fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(recipient_city_name) = 'BUFFALO' AND recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025'
In which states did doctors receive the most money from drug and device makers in 2024?

SELECT recipient_state, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are based outside the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_country_code <> 'USA'
How many patent lawsuits were filed each year from 2011 to 2020?

SELECT substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which federal district courts handled the most civil cases in the Federal Judicial Center's database?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database AS f JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = f.district_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Maryland or Virginia get more federal contract dollars in fiscal year 2019?

SELECT primary_place_of_performance_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code IN ('MD', 'VA') AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2019' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
How many Medicaid prescriptions were filled in New York in 2021?
SELECT sum(try_cast(number_of_prescriptions AS double)) AS prescriptions FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2021' AND state = 'NY'
How many active community water systems are there in the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
Which Florida cities recorded the most fatal crashes in 2022?
SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'Florida' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Zenodo physics and chemistry records were published each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT publication_year, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records WHERE try_cast(publication_year AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states have the highest median gross rent?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_rent FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.variable = 'B25064_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published patent applications contributed reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications
Which states paid the most for Medicaid prescriptions in 2022?
SELECT state, sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND state <> 'XX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much NIH money went to Johns Hopkins University in fiscal year 2020?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_name = 'JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2020'
What is the median household income in Kings County, New York, in the 2020 to 2024 American Community Survey?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36047' AND variable = 'B19013_E001'
How many people filed to run for president in 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'P' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Where do medical device problems happen most often: hospitals, homes or clinics?
SELECT event_location, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pieces of research software are archived in the Zenodo collection?
SELECT count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records WHERE resource_type_general = 'Software'
What is the average molecular mass of a compound in PubChem?
SELECT avg(try_cast(c2 AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass
What share of Rhea's pH 7.3 compound mappings were set by hand rather than computed?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN origin = 'curation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_chebi_ph7_3_mapping
Which organisations have deposited the most bioassays in PubChem?
SELECT depositorname, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2depositorname WHERE depositorname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people does a community water system serve on average?
SELECT avg(try_cast(population_served_count AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
Which neighbouring grids did New York trade the most power with in 2023?

SELECT directly_interconnected_balancing_authority, sum(abs(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double))) AS mwh_traded FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND data_date LIKE '%/2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many ChEBI compounds carry a negative charge?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_chemical_data WHERE charge < 0
Which papers from 2012, the year the Higgs boson was found, have been cited most?
SELECT title, try_cast(citation_count AS integer) AS citations FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE substr(earliest_date, 1, 4) = '2012' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What are the ten most recent CRS reports with student loans in the title?
SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'CRS' AND lower(title) LIKE '%student loan%' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 10
Which institutions have received the most National Science Foundation award dollars?
SELECT name, sum(try_cast(awardamount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who ran for the U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania in 2024?
SELECT DISTINCT cand_name, cand_pty_affiliation FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'S' AND cand_office_st = 'PA' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Which materials carry the strongest magnetization per formula unit?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(total_magnetization_normalized_formula_units AS double) AS magnetization FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many bioassays does PubChem hold?
What kinds of informal enforcement do regulators use most against water polluters?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were total reported greenhouse gas emissions, in tons of carbon dioxide equivalent, in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission WHERE year = '2022'
Which categories of drinking water violation are most common?

SELECT CASE violation_category_code WHEN 'MCL' THEN 'Maximum contaminant level' WHEN 'MR' THEN 'Monitoring and reporting' WHEN 'MON' THEN 'Monitoring' WHEN 'RPT' THEN 'Reporting' WHEN 'TT' THEN 'Treatment technique' WHEN 'MRDL' THEN 'Maximum residual disinfectant level' ELSE violation_category_code END AS category, count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Labor Department rules about overtime have appeared on the regulatory agenda?
SELECT DISTINCT rin, rule_title FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE acronym LIKE '%DOL%' AND lower(rule_title) LIKE '%overtime%' LIMIT 10
Which databases contribute the most compound records to UniChem?

SELECT s.name_long, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_chemistry.unichem_reference AS r JOIN govblock_chemistry.unichem_source AS s ON cast(s.src_id AS varchar) = cast(r.src_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of drinking water violations are classed as major?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN is_major_viol_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_major_viol_ind IS NOT NULL
Where were the most public schools closed in 2022-23?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS closed FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE sy_status_text = 'Closed' AND school_year = '2022-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is aspirin's CAS registry number?
SELECT c1 AS cas_number FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c0 = '2244' AND c2 = 'CAS'
Which grid operators exported the most electricity to their neighbours in 2023?
SELECT balancing_authority, sum(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double)) AS net_export_mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE data_date LIKE '%/2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent cases were filed in the Eastern District of Texas in 2015?
SELECT count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE court_name = 'Eastern District of Texas' AND substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2015'
Which countries do inventors on U.S. patent applications come from most often?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average energy of the aspirin frames in revised MD17?
SELECT avg(energy_kcal_mol) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.rmd17_frames WHERE molecule = 'aspirin'
Which industries hold the most water discharge permits?
SELECT sic_desc, count(DISTINCT npdes_id) AS permits FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_sics GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds were confirmed active against HIV in the screening set?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_hiv WHERE activity = 'CA'
What did the Department of Defense buy most in Hawaii in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT product_or_service_code_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'HI' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many injuries have owners of the Tesla Model 3 reported in their complaints?
SELECT sum(try_cast(injured AS integer)) AS injured FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE maketxt = 'TESLA' AND modeltxt = 'MODEL 3'
Which counties in Florida have the oldest median age?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_age FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US12%' AND a.variable = 'B01002_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies based outside the United States file financial statements with the SEC?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE countryba <> 'US'
Which New York cities have the most public schools?
SELECT lcity, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE st = 'NY' AND school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many words do Florida's statutes run to in all?
SELECT sum(try_cast(word_count AS bigint)) AS words FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'fl' AND document_type = 'statute'
Which companies received the most federal contract money for work in Alaska in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'AK' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which medical subject heading is attached to PubChem compound 2244?
SELECT c1 AS mesh_heading FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mesh WHERE c0 = '2244' LIMIT 10
Which statutes are cited most often as the cause of action in federal dockets?
SELECT cause, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE cause IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Navy contract dollars in Virginia went to small businesses in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'VA' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which trial judges' rulings are appealed most often?
SELECT ordering_judge_str, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE ordering_judge_str IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which drugs cost Medicare Part D the most in New York?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT gnrc_name, sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_state_abrvtn = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the most sections of law in the library?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Where do New York hospital patients go after they are discharged?
SELECT patient_disposition, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which publishers appear most often among Zenodo research records?
SELECT publisher, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which California counties had the most fatal crashes in 2020?
SELECT countyname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'California' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which agencies bought the most from small businesses in New York last fiscal year?

SELECT awarding_agency_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size = 'SMALL BUSINESS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which FCC licence files hold the most active licences?
SELECT uls_file, count(*) AS active_licences FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_uls_l_hd WHERE column05 = 'A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do federal campaigns spend money on most, by category?
SELECT category_desc, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
